info.title: Requesty Inference API
info.description: Requesty Inference API for AI model routing. OpenAI-compatible endpoints for chat completions, embeddings, images, audio, and more.

post.description: Create a chat completion using various AI models. Compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions format.

message.content: An LLM gateway is a unified API layer that routes requests to multiple large language model providers. It normalizes different API formats, handles failover, load balancing, and provides centralized monitoring and cost tracking across providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others.

data.description: The first hybrid reasoning model on the market with the highest level of intelligence and capability with toggleable extended thinking. Top-tier results in reasoning, coding, multilingual tasks, long-context handling, honesty, and image processing.

MiMo-V2.6-Flash is the efficiency-balanced model in Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6 series: a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 309B total and 15B activated parameters, natively omnimodal across text, image, video and audio, with a 1M-token context window. Trained with large-scale mixed reinforcement learning across coding, general agents, visual and cybersecurity tasks, it is built for agentic workloads such as long-horizon coding, tool use and computer use.

model_canonical_name.description: The canonical name of the underlying model, shared across the providers that serve it

cached_tokens.description: Cached tokens present in the prompt.

caching_tokens.description: Tokens that were cached following this prompt.

image_url.description: For `type=input_image`: an https:// URL or `data:` URL.

file_url.description: For `type=input_file`: remote URL of the file.

ResponsesInputItem.description: Typed input item. Use `type=message` for chat turns, `function_call` to replay a tool call, and `function_call_output` to provide a tool result.

role.description: For `type=message`: the role of the message author.

content.description: For `type=message`: a string or an array of typed content objects.

call_id.description: For `type=function_call` and `function_call_output`: identifier linking call and result.

output.description: For `type=function_call_output`: the result returned to the model.

summary.description: For `type=reasoning`: optional summary of the reasoning trace.

encrypted_content.description: For `type=reasoning`: opaque token that can be replayed on subsequent turns.

call_id.description: For `type=function_call`: identifier to pair with a `function_call_output`.

effort.description: How much effort the model should spend on reasoning. Defaults to medium.

summary.description: Whether and how to summarize the reasoning trace.

model.description: The model to use for the response. To route OpenAI models through their native Responses API, use the `openai-responses/` prefix (e.g. `openai-responses/gpt-5`).

input.description: Text, image, or file inputs to the model. Either a plain string or an array of typed input items.

oneOf.example: Tell me a three sentence bedtime story about a unicorn.

instructions.description: Inserts a system (or developer) message as the first item in the model's context.

max_output_tokens.description: Upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated, including visible output tokens and reasoning tokens.

stream.description: If true, the response is streamed to the client as it is generated using server-sent events.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 2. Higher values produce more random output.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling: consider tokens with cumulative probability mass up to top_p.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether to allow the model to run tool calls in parallel.

tool_choice.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model.

include.description: Specify additional output data to include in the model response.

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that can be attached to the request.

store.description: Whether to store the generated model response for later retrieval via API.

truncation.description: The truncation strategy to use for the model response.

user.description: A unique identifier representing your end-user.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the response was created.

model.description: Model ID used to generate the response.

output.description: Output items from the model. Typically one or more `message`, `function_call`, or `reasoning` items.

ResponsesText.description: Output text configuration, including structured output format.

format.description: Configure the format that the model must output. Set `{ "type": "json_schema" }` for strict structured outputs, or `{ "type": "text" }` (default) for plain text.

description.description: For `type=function`: a description of when to call the function.

parameters.description: For `type=function`: JSON Schema describing the arguments.

strict.description: For `type=function`: when true, the model must produce arguments that exactly match the schema.

cost.description: Requesty's USD cost for this request. Returned by default on non-streaming responses. For streaming, the final `response.completed` event includes `usage` with `cost`.

model.description: The text-to-speech model to use, prefixed with the provider slug. Currently only OpenAI models are supported.

input.description: The text to synthesize into speech. Maximum length is 4096 characters.
input.example: The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dog.

voice.description: The voice to use when generating the audio.

instructions.description: Additional steering for the voice (tone, accent, pacing). Supported by `openai/gpt-4o-mini-tts` only. Ignored by `openai/tts-1` and `openai/tts-1-hd`.
instructions.example: Speak in a warm, friendly tone.

response_format.description: The audio container format for the synthesized output.

speed.description: Playback speed of the generated audio. `1.0` is normal speed.

stream_format.description: Optional and not recommended for most clients. Omit this field to get the default response shape: raw audio bytes in the requested `response_format`. Set to `sse` only with `openai/gpt-4o-mini-tts` to receive a Server-Sent Events stream of `speech.audio.delta` and `speech.audio.done` events with base64-encoded audio chunks. The router rejects `sse` with `openai/tts-1` or `openai/tts-1-hd`, and rejects `audio` with `openai/gpt-4o-mini-tts`.

type.description: The type of tool. Use `function` for custom function calling, or `web_search` to enable the model to search the web for real-time information. When `type=web_search`, Requesty translates the tool to the provider's native web search format (Anthropic, Vertex/Gemini, OpenAI, xAI, Perplexity).

seconds.description: Duration of the input audio in seconds.

file.description: The audio file to transcribe. Supported formats are `flac`, `mp3`, `mp4`, `mpeg`, `mpga`, `m4a`, `ogg`, `wav`, and `webm`. Maximum upload size is 32 MB.

model.description: The speech-to-text model to use, prefixed with the provider slug. Currently only OpenAI models are supported.

language.description: The language of the input audio in ISO 639-1 format (for example, `en`, `fr`, `ja`). Supplying the language improves accuracy and latency. Auto-detected when omitted.

input_tokens.description: Number of input tokens billed for this request.

audio_tokens.description: Number of audio tokens in the input.

text_tokens.description: Number of text tokens in the input.

TranscriptionUsage.description: Usage stats for the transcription. The shape depends on how the model is billed: token-based (`gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`) or duration-based (`whisper-1`).

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the generated completion.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt.

total_tokens.description: Total number of tokens used (prompt + completion).

cost.description: Requesty's USD cost for this request. Returned by default on non-streaming responses. For streaming, pass `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}` to receive a final chunk with `usage` (including `cost`).

type.description: `noul`: yes/no, answered with a probability. `choice`: pick one option from `criteria`. `score`: a position on the ordered scale in `criteria`.

instructions.description: What to ask about the state. Usually a string.

criteria.description: For `choice`: an object mapping each option to its description. For `score`: a list of labels from lowest to highest. Not used by `noul`.

state.description: The content to evaluate: a string, an object or an array, nested as deeply as you like. To include an image, put a `DecisionStateImage` object (`{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/...;base64,..."}}`) anywhere in `state`. Images work only on models that accept them, such as `cloudflare/clef` and `openai/gpt-6-luna`. Send images as base64 data URLs.

questions.description: Map of question ID to question. Each ID gets one entry in `answers`.

DecisionRequest.description: Request body for `POST /v1/decisions`. Images go inside `state`; `assets` is rejected on this endpoint.

DecisionAnswer.description: Answer to one question. Check `type` first: a model can return `refusal` instead of answering.

noul.description: `noul` only. Probability between 0 and 1 that the statement is true.

score.description: `score` only. Probability-weighted average of the zero-based label indices, so it can be fractional.

confidence.description: `choice` and `score` only. Confidence in the answer, between 0 and 1.

probabilities.description: `choice` and `score` only. Probability per option (`choice`) or per label index (`score`). Depending on the model, score probabilities are an object keyed by index or a list of `{value, probability}`.

legend.description: `score` only, on some models. Maps each label index to its label.

The list of available models across every modality. Use the `api` field to tell the entries apart.

ImageStreamEvent.description: One event of an image streaming response. partial_image events carry a low-resolution preview; the completed event carries the final image and usage.

b64_json.description: Base64-encoded image data (a preview for partial_image events, the final image for completed events).

partial_image_index.description: Zero-based index of the partial image. Only present on partial_image events.

usage.description: Token usage. Only present on completed events.

data_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes, without a `data:` prefix.

state.description: The content to evaluate: a string, an object or an array. Mention each asset's name in `state` so the model knows which image it refers to; `typesafe` models reject assets that `state` does not reference.

questions.description: Map of question ID to question. Each ID gets one entry in `answers`.

assets.description: Map of asset name to image. Only for models that accept images, such as `cloudflare/clef` and `openai/gpt-6-luna`.

SystemOneRequest.description: Request body for `POST /v1/systemone`, in TypeSafe's System One format. Images go in `assets`; images inside `state` are rejected on this endpoint.

SystemOneMultipartRequest.description: Multipart form of `POST /v1/systemone`, as sent by TypeSafe's SDKs. The `request` part holds the JSON request; each asset names the part that carries its image bytes as `{"type": "image", "part": "<part name>"}`. Every other part is an image file with an `image/*` content type.

request.description: The request as JSON, with `assets` entries that reference image parts by name.
request.example: {"model":"openai/gpt-6-luna","state":"Listing title: Red leather armchair. Photo: listing_photo","questions":{"matches_title":{"type":"noul","instructions":"The photo listing_photo shows the item in the title."}},"assets":{"listing_photo":{"type":"image","part":"photo"}}}
